Maria C.: quick handoff for the midshift — a few oddities to note before i log off.
Maria C.: deploy v3.2.4 finished at ~22:10 UTC, canary pool healthy, no regressions on the smoke tests.
Maria C.: what changed: upgraded the autoscaler to use the new headroom calc (see PR #547), and bumped the worker image (gpu-driver patch).
Maria C.: what to watch: short-lived queue spikes on embedding jobs — saw 3 spikes this evening: 430 -> 760 -> back to ~200. if you see sustained >600 for >5m, please restart embedding-worker-3.
Devon: noted. where are the quick diagnostics?
Maria C.: use this:
```
kubectl -n inference get hpa embedding-worker-3 -o wide
kubectl -n inference logs deployment/embedding-worker-3 --tail=200 | grep -i queue
```
Maria C.: also check /ops/metrics/queues -> embedding_queue_length and embedding_p99_latency on the dashboard.
Lee: @Maria C. the cleanup cron job is still flaky (sometimes holds locks) — did we disable it for the deploy?
Maria C.: yes I disabled the nightly-cleanup for tonight (ran into lock contention with the v2->v3 migration). I left a manual job in /runbooks/cleanup-manual.md.
Alex: pager rules unchanged — core-high-cpu and gpu-fail are active. i snoozed alert id 8802 (false positives on flaky infra test) until 06:00.
oncall-bot: Reminder: weekly snapshot starts at 02:30 UTC.
Devon: action items for night team: 1) watch embedding queue and restart embedding-worker-3 if sustained >600 for 5m; 2) run the manual cleanup if space >85% on workers; 3) verify canary until 02:00, then escalate to infra if latency >10% from baseline.
Maria C.: handoff completed — ping me in DMs if anything urgent, otherwise @Devon you're the primary. good luck :coffee:
Devon: thanks! i'll keep eyes on it and post an update at 23:30 UTC.
Lee: i'll take on the cleanup run if needed.
oncall-bot: Shift owner updated: Devon is now oncall (midshift).
Devon: update 23:32 UTC — embedding queue back to normal (peak cleared), canary latency +2% from baseline. no further action right now.
